fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6ZCC (Builders and fixers reproduce). The intent: two nebari runs on 2026-11-09 reproduced a flaky test by starting 8 and 14 busy loops on the shared 4-core VM, holding load at 16-22 for 15-30+ minutes and slowing every other live run, while load-based repro barely worked (45/45 passed) and a 500 ms injected delay on the suspected request reproduced 10/10. No owner was present; the planner asked three questions, which the arbiter decided in decision-delay-repro-scope: the change set serves milestone-25 (empty backlog: bugs and polish), like the earlier unstable-CI guidance and flaky-test fixes; it is guidance only, putting the rule 'reproduce timing flakes by injecting a delay at the suspected race, never by busy loops or parallel stress on the host' into the build and review guide topics (the source of the rhiza-build and rhiza-review skills) and into this repo's CLAUDE.md beside the unstable-CI reproduce-locally rule; the optional watchdog flagging runs' descendant processes at 100% CPU is left out, to be planned as its own change set later. Planned: one leaf, delay-repro-guidance, under self-check next to unstable-ci-guidance, checked by the guide text tests and the CLAUDE.md test.
fields.title: Plan interview: builders and fixers reproduce flakes by delay, not CPU load
